A real calibrated X11 swipe capture showed no centered time readout or tall vertical seek line; the hero remained free of the old center HUD.

The candidate supplied no two legible mid-gesture captures; its own records show atomic drag calls followed by settled screenshots rather than live target samples.
A fresh playback from the beginning, followed by a calibrated rightward swipe of about 200px, landed at 18.36s on an 83.78s track, matching the roughly 17.5s target implied by the gesture.
No candidate-owned screenshot is traceable to an actually in-flight gesture; the candidate's screenshot calls occurred after atomic drag calls and delay, not between incremental pointer updates.
The genuine post-gesture screenshot shows the normal folder line (~) and no lingering seek readout or center indicator.
The settled verification tree independently reports the normal ~ folder text and a null seek-preview state, agreeing with the screenshot.

An on-screen X11 play/pause tap clearly toggled playback, and the tree exposed previous/play/next controls; the combined previous/next probe ended with no active track, so all tap-zone transitions and vertical behavior were not fully established.
Repeated calibrated real-X11 swipes left the live app responsive; the verification runtime reported zero overflow/error reports and the process remained alive.
